harnessNotes: The first two failed compatibility checks used the SDK focused-view API as a gate after tab changes. They are not counted as product defects or fixes.
The final helper first verifies that the original cards tab is foreground and its selected header and stage are present, then simulates user focus before checking the focused-view API.
No automatic openCards focus fix or change in product focus behavior is claimed.
The local host test run initially lacked its required cards build. After that prebuild, all 255 local tests passed; the clean official host run passed 251 tests.
limitations: This record covers the native macOS acceptance vault, not physical Windows.
A whole-tab black screen was not reproduced; its cause or resolution is not established.
System-level disconnected-network testing and deployment into existing personal vaults are not claimed here.
Acceptance helpers, raw vault data, note paths, fixture IDs and local absolute paths are excluded.
